topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic opens the lecture by connecting to previous practical work and outlining the session's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Viral Origins of Oncogenes and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how tumor virology revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and how cellular transformation is measured experimentally.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer gene categories and examine how oncogenic, tumor-suppressive, and dominant-negative mutations perturb cellular regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the molecular repair failures, replication errors, and mitotic abnormalities that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer.

topics.label: Multi-Step Tumor Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how the sequential acquisition of mutations drives tumor development across both sporadic cancers and inherited cancer syndromes.

topics.label: Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing with a reading recommendation and an outlook toward the next lecture.
